description: One wait record. The declarative wait-rule engine dedupes on a fact hash of the wait's content; a surfaced wait becomes exactly one owner item. A decision lands on the wait through the item's decision (owner_approved / owner_denied, decided_at, owner_note). A terminal status post from the owning thread resolves its pending waits — an ack alone never does.

card.description: Card-watch provenance, present only on a permission_card wait posted by the card watcher (card-owner plan): the normalized card DTO as mapped, whitelist fields only (raw tool arguments never appear), with the history-stamped outcome and decision time added at resolution.

wait_class.description: Hard-stop classes are named in code and never auto-applied or rule-eligible.

title: Wait record (contract 05)
